SELECT t.moment_id, t.user_id, t.created_at FROM (SELECT l.moment_id, l.user_id, l.created_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.moment_id ORDER BY l.created_at DESC) AS rn FROM im_moment_like l WHERE l.moment_id IN
